court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principle Judge, Family Court, Lucknow in Regular Suit No. 1268 of 2012
case_name: Aayush Rastogi vs Principal Judge Family Court Lucknow
facts_of_case: Marriage between Aayush Rastogi and Smt. Malvika Rastogi was solemnized on 11.12.2011. After marriage, respondent no.2-Smt. Malvika Rastogi went back to Kolkata and returned with appellant. She made an attempt to commit suicide on 29.02.2012. Appellant filed a petition under Section-12 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: A person who is mentally not sound, although not an idiot or lunatic, is disqualified from contracting a valid marriage.
legal_principles.held: a clear intention of the legislature that a person who is mentally not sound although he may not be an idiot or lunatic, is disqualified from contracting a valid marriage
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR 205 MP

legal_principles.principle: The degree of mental illness for grant of a decree of divorce may not be the same for grant of nullity.
legal_principles.held: the degree of mental illness for grant of a decree of divorce may not be the same for grant of degree of nullity
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR 205 MP

legal_principles.principle: A situation where the other spouse at the time of marriage may be in a lucid interval and hence in a capacity to give a valid consent, but otherwise suffers from such mental disorder as disables her/him from discharging marital obligations.
legal_principles.held: the provision in section 5(ii)(b) thus envisages a situation where the other spouses at the time of marriage may be in lucid interval and hence in a capacity to give a valid consent
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR 205 MP

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be compelled to suffer marital life with a marriage partner who is not mentally sound and is only fit for procreation of children.
legal_principles.held: a party can not be compelled to suffer marital life with a marriage partner who is not mentally sound and is only fit for procreation of children
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR 205 MP

outcome.final_order: Divorce petition under Section 12(1) (c) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 moved by the appellant was dismissed. Appeal is allowed.

keywords: Aayush Rastogi Vs. Smt. Malvika Rastogi
